description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and operational excellence. The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting. This full-time position comes with a highly competitive salary, reflecting the importance of this leadership role. Join a team committed to quality and innovation in long-term care.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care environment
Strong leadership, operational management, and financial acumen
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Demonstrated ability to foster a positive culture and achieve quality outcomes
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.
